description: Google News search (public Google News RSS search feed, no key, English/US edition): headline, publisher, publish time and the Google News link for the newest matching stories. Google News links redirect to the publisher; article text is not returned. Takes about 12 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: search_google_ads when you need Google Ads Transparency Center: search advertisers by name; search_google_search when you need Organic web search results from the Brave Search API: rank. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: search_google_news
title: Google News search: headline, publisher, publish time
